import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] moveX = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] moveY = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int sizeN, maxT, startXCoord, startYCoord;
    static String[] gridLab = new String[20], gridSci = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][][] memoDP = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] capGraph = new int[250][250], parentNode = new int[250];
    static int[][] distMap = new int[20][20], visitedMap = new int[20][20];

    static boolean isAccessible(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < sizeN && 0 <= y && y < sizeN && gridLab[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && gridLab[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static void initializeDistances() {
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distMap[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
            Arrays.fill(visitedMap[i], 0);
        }
        distMap[startXCoord][startYCoord] = 0;
        visitedMap[startXCoord][startYCoord] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.offer(startXCoord);
        qy.offer(startYCoord);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int dirIdx = 0; dirIdx < 4; dirIdx++) {
                int nx = x + moveX[dirIdx];
                int ny = y + moveY[dirIdx];
                if (isAccessible(nx, ny) && visitedMap[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    distMap[nx][ny] = distMap[x][y] + 1;
                    visitedMap[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.offer(nx);
                    qy.offer(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean findPath(int xA, int yA, int xB, int yB, int stepCount) {
        if (stepCount > maxT) return false;
        int res = memoDP[xA][yA][xB][yB][stepCount];
        if (res != -1) return res == 1;
        if (xA == xB && yA == yB) return distMap[xA][yA] >= stepCount;
        if (distMap[xA][yA] <= stepCount) return false;
        for (int dirIdx = 0; dirIdx < 4; dirIdx++) {
            int nx = xA + moveX[dirIdx];
            int ny = yA + moveY[dirIdx];
            if (isAccessible(nx, ny) && findPath(nx, ny, xB, yB, stepCount + 1))
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean runFlow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(parentNode, -1);
        parentNode[s] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int i = s; i <= t; i++) {
                if (parentNode[i] == -1 && capGraph[v][i] > 0) {
                    parentNode[i] = v;
                    q.offer(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return parentNode[t] != -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        sizeN = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        maxT = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; i++) {
            gridSci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; i++) {
            gridLab[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        List<int[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> loadCapacities = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> supplyCapacities = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeN; j++) {
                if (gridSci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    startXCoord = i;
                    startYCoord = j;
                } else if ('0' <= gridSci[i].charAt(j) && gridSci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    points.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    loadCapacities.add(gridLab[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    supplyCapacities.add(gridSci[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        int m = points.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(capGraph[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            capGraph[0][i + 1] = supplyCapacities.get(i);
            capGraph[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = loadCapacities.get(i);
        }
        initializeDistances();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        Arrays.fill(memoDP[i][j][k][l], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                int x1 = points.get(i)[0], y1 = points.get(i)[1];
                int x2 = points.get(j)[0], y2 = points.get(j)[1];
                if (findPath(x1, y1, x2, y2, 0)) {
                    capGraph[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (runFlow(0, 2 * m + 1)) {
            int current = 2 * m + 1;
            int flowVal = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            while (parentNode[current] >= 0) {
                flowVal = Math.min(flowVal, capGraph[parentNode[current]][current]);
                current = parentNode[current];
            }
            current = 2 * m + 1;
            while (parentNode[current] >= 0) {
                capGraph[parentNode[current]][current] -= flowVal;
                capGraph[current][parentNode[current]] += flowVal;
                current = parentNode[current];
            }
            totalFlow += flowVal;
        }
        System.out.println(totalFlow);
    }
}
